Couch themes: "Arcade Pixel Art" mockups

Mockups only, no app code changed. Same home-screen layout as today (game preview, details, scan-to-join, console row, cover row, hints). In the pixel theme, the whole screen restyles itself to match whichever console is selected: colours, panel style, fonts, button glyphs, background, and the shape of the game covers (cartridge, CD case, UMD, HuCard…). Game art here is placeholder pixel art.

Arcade Pixel Art: one look per console
